name: nylonme
description: Long-term memory for Codex via the NylonME memory engine — weave decisions, milestones and pitfalls at the end of a session, resonate them back at the start of the next.

interface.shortDescription: Long-term memory for Codex — remember across sessions
interface.longDescription: Gives Codex a persistent memory backed by the NylonME memory engine. Codex recalls relevant project context at session start (memory_resonate) and weaves decisions, milestones and environment pitfalls at milestones (memory_weave), so knowledge survives across sessions, machines and tools. Runs fully local (embedded engine, data in ~/.nylonme/data) or against a shared team engine via NYLON_SERVER.
